scripts.prebuild: node -e "if (process.env.VITE_E2E) { console.error('VITE_E2E must not be set when building'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.ports:kill:vite: ps -ax -o pid=,command= | grep '[v]ite' | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -r kill
scripts.dev:clean: npm run ports:kill:repo && npm run dev:strict
scripts.build:verify:prod: npm run build && (rg -n '__setContactState|__triggerLeadSend|__lastLeadPayload|data-testid=\"chat-shell\"|data-glowing|VITE_E2E' dist && exit 1 || true) && (rg -n 'data-testid' dist && exit 1 || true)
scripts.ci:prod: npm run build:verify:prod && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false
